full_judgment: 17. If we glean the said provision it transpires that a finally published record of rights revised under Section 144(A) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act has a presumption of correctness and that presumption continues till it is otherwise rebutted by reliable evidence. This proposition of law is well settled. In the case in hand since the R.S record has been prepared in the name of Government, the plaintiff could not produce any reliable evidence to controvert the same, so the submissions of the learned Advocate in this regard is a falacious one.
